headerDisplay: Unofficial plugin for Glue smart locks. Create an API key with your Glue account and enter it below.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: The API key issued for your Glue account. It needs the scopes locks.read, locks.write and events.read.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often the plugin reads the lock status from Glue. Minimum 15 seconds.

lowBatteryThreshold.title: Low battery threshold (%)
lowBatteryThreshold.description: HomeKit shows a low battery warning when the battery level is below this value.
